title: Trace the public Media Foundation CDM discovery first failure
question: At which public factory or type-support stage does an identical explicit query first fail or report unsupported on Windows and Wine?
acceptance_criteria: The executable builds from public Windows SDK interfaces with warnings as errors.
No key system is queried unless an operator supplies one explicitly.
The trace distinguishes HRESULT failure, semantic unsupported, and unrequested stages.
Source and direct imports contain no CDM access/session/license/network operation.
Paired Windows and Wine runs use the same executable hash and explicit input before a runtime verdict is assigned.
